venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
headline: First quarter, 8:49. Hitch to Brown. First quarter, 12:07. Coleman in the lane. Faulkner is trying to run it until they sit. White is trying to make him hold it. That is the night.

offense.body:
First quarter, 8:49, first-and-10, FAU 49. Sit here.

Philo in the gun. Baugh on his left. Three to the field, one to the boundary. The tight end is split out in the trips — not on the tackle. Two safeties high. Corners at eight yards.

Faulkner is counting. If they bring a body down, Baugh has the give. They do not. They sit. So Philo does not hunt it. Hitch to Brown. Catch at the 50. First man misses. Brown runs 49 yards.

People will remember the score. The play is the throw. On time, after they refused the run. Brown is in that window because he makes the first miss.

The rest of the night is that snap showing up again.

They opened at their own 6 the same way — shotgun, Baugh for 9. Then 10:50, hitch to Brown for 8. 9:14, after they dropped Philo, Wilson short left, 19. Stay on the field. Come back to the run.

7:17, Baugh left, the front clogs, he bounces 18. 6:34 from the 12, they throw it now to Stockton on the right, he finishes. 4:21, they hand Brown the run they have been throwing him.

Second quarter, 13:22. FAU just scored. The safety is cheating Baugh. Extra bodies stay in. Abrams runs by everybody. 63 to the 8. That shot only exists because the run was real.

11:05, fourth-and-3 from the 3. Faulkner empties it. Five out. The ends have to declare. They climb. Philo walks in.

Baugh again at 4:05 — 12, backside cut — and 2:51, bounce, pad, dive, 7. Third quarter, 13:59, third-and-2, the crease, 61 to the 6, then through the pile at 13:11. He said he would run it when the stadium knew.

7:20, they sit for Baugh again. Brown over the top, 33. 4:29, Clark is the back, the linebackers sit, he releases, catch at the 4, he drives it in.

0:44 of the second, third-and-7 at the FAU 44. Philo holds it. Sweeney sits. The window is only open if he throws it now.
bullets: 8:49 1st, FAU 49: trips, tight end split. They sit. Hitch to Brown. Miss. 49.
12:00 1st: Baugh for 9. Same answer they opened with.
0:44 2nd: he holds it. Sweeney takes it.

defense.body:
First quarter, 12:07, third-and-10, Florida 35. Sit here.

Veltkamp in the gun. Trips one side. White does not send anyone. Four rush. Two high. Everybody else drops.

The ball comes out late. Coleman is already in the lane. He catches it at the 5. Drive over.

That is the defense. Make him hold it. Do not open a window.

The rest of the night is that plan, and the jobs inside it.

They opened at 14:27, third-and-7, corners off, hitch to Henry, converted. White will live with that throw if they tackle.

13:55 of the second, first-and-goal at the 1. He packs the box. No bounce. Ervin still walks in. The front was right. They lost the pile.

6:52, third-and-7 at the 7. Same four-rush. The end leaves. Veltkamp dives the pylon. Same call as Coleman. Different job.

4:01, first snap after Baugh scored. Heat up the middle. Duck. Johnson at the 30. Coleman on the breakup. Same wait. They took it again.

1:18 of the third, first-and-10 at the Florida 20. Corners still off. Valsin stacks Flowers and wins the back line. If you sit off all night to kill the deep ball, you have to win the fade when they throw it.

6:45 of the fourth, fourth-and-1 at the 1. Veltkamp keeps left. Bett gets there. Ball out. Myles Johnson falls on it. The rush finally finishes.
bullets: 12:07 1st, Florida 35: four rush, two-high. Late ball. Coleman at the 5.
14:27 1st: corners off. Hitch to Henry. That is the tax.
13:55 2nd: packed box. Ervin still in. Lost the pile.
4:01 2nd: heat, duck, Johnson. Same wait as Coleman.
1:18 3rd: Valsin fade. Flowers loses the back line.

specials.body: First quarter, 2:10, fourth-and-4, FAU 35. They can go for it. They let Durkin try it from 53. Clean. Florida never punts.

keys: 8:49: they sit, hitch to Brown. That is Faulkner.
12:07: four rush, late ball, Coleman. That is White.
They lose when the pile, the edge, or the fade loses.
Campbell will throw hitch and run the quarterback. Same two jobs.

nextWeek.look: They will go fast and throw hitch. Faulkner will still run Baugh until they sit. White will still rush four. The snaps that matter are the short throw and whether the end stays home.
